shots.scene: 欣欣站在一栋三层实验楼模型旁，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a three-story laboratory building model and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲工程控制。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着模型上的屋顶风机和楼里的生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a roof fan on the model and a small biological safety cabinet inside it.
shots.narration: 从一栋楼，讲到一台柜子。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白课程表，站在生物实验楼门口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank schedule sheet in front of a biology laboratory building.
shots.narration: 阿杰下周要进二级实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰抬头看楼顶一排排风机，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up at a row of exhaust fans on the roof and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 他问：楼顶这些风机干啥用？

shots.scene: 老李从楼里走出来，手里拿着空白图纸，向阿杰招手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks out of the building holding a blank blueprint and waves to the young male student.
shots.narration: 老李说：走，带你从头看。

shots.scene: 五个叠放的方块图标：叉号、交换箭头、齿轮、文件夹、口罩
shots.prompt_en: Five stacked block icons: a cross, swap arrows, a gear, a folder and a face mask. No people.
shots.narration: 控制风险有五招：消除、替代，

shots.scene: 齿轮、文件夹、口罩三个图标用线连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A gear icon, a folder icon and a mask icon linked together by lines. No people.
shots.narration: 工程、管理、个人防护。

shots.scene: 小研坐在生物安全柜前，旁边立着一份空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a biological safety cabinet with a blank procedure document standing beside her.
shots.narration: 它们不是单用，而是同时用。

shots.scene: 安全柜图标和文件图标握手
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon and a document icon shake hands. No people.
shots.narration: 用安全柜，也得照规程做。

shots.section_title: 管安全的人，也要懂设施
shots.scene: 王老师和老李对着空白图纸讨论，旁边一位建筑师样的人物轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer discuss a blank blueprint together.
shots.narration: 管生物安全的人，
overlay: 管安全的人，也要懂设施

shots.section_title: 管安全的人，也要懂设施
shots.scene: 王老师在空白笔记本上画出简单的房间草图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sketches a simple room outline in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 也要懂一点设施设计，

shots.section_title: 管安全的人，也要懂设施
shots.scene: 王老师和老李相互点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer nod to each other.
shots.narration: 才能和工程师说到一块。

shots.section_title: 机器在楼上，实验室里不放
shots.scene: 老李带阿杰登上楼顶的设备层，满是风管、风机和控制柜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer leads the young male student into an upper service floor full of ducts, fans and control panels.
shots.narration: 风机、过滤器、电控柜，
overlay: 机器在楼上，实验室里不放

shots.section_title: 机器在楼上，实验室里不放
shots.scene: 剖面图：上层满是机器，下层实验室里很简洁
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: the upper floor is full of machines while the laboratory below is clean and simple. No people.
shots.narration: 都装在实验室上方的设备层。

shots.section_title: 机器在楼上，实验室里不放
shots.scene: 实验室内部干净整齐，只有台面和安全柜
shots.prompt_en: A tidy laboratory interior with only benches and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不放机械，便于密封清洁。

shots.section_title: 级别越高，设施要求越多
shots.scene: 四级台阶，从低到高标着一到四
shots.prompt_en: Four steps rising from low to high, each with a blank plaque. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全实验室分一到四级。
overlay: 级别越高，设施要求越多

shots.section_title: 级别越高，设施要求越多
shots.scene: 台阶上逐级增加图标：门、密封条、风扇、安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Icons are added step by step on the stairs: a door, a seal strip, a fan and a safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 级别越高，设施要求越多。

shots.section_title: 级别越高，设施要求越多
shots.scene: 三级、四级台阶上出现独立房间和密封门图标
shots.prompt_en: On the third and fourth steps, icons of an isolated room and a sealed door appear. No people.
shots.narration: 三、四级要独立隔离，

shots.section_title: 级别越高，设施要求越多
shots.scene: 房间门窗风口都被封好，房里充满淡淡雾气
shots.prompt_en: A room with doors, windows and vents all sealed and filled with a faint mist. No people.
shots.narration: 房间能密封，做气体熏蒸消毒。

shots.scene: 地图上只有一处亮着的四级实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: A map with only one glowing level four laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 四级实验室造价和运行都很贵，

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一到三级台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the first three steps.
shots.narration: 我们平常接触的是一到三级。

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 空白示意图：一个蓝色方框，门口出现生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a blue box with a biohazard warning sign at its door. No people.
shots.narration: 看一座防护设施怎么搭：
overlay: 一座防护设施由什么组成

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 方框外围加上一圈红色密封线
shots.prompt_en: A red sealing line is drawn around the blue box. No people.
shots.narration: 门口有标志，房间能密封，

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 蓝色箭头从一侧流入，绿色箭头经滤网从顶部排出
shots.prompt_en: A blue arrow flows in from one side and a green arrow exits through a filter at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 气流定向流入，过滤后排出，

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 方框内显示减号图标
shots.prompt_en: A minus icon appears inside the box. No people.
shots.narration: 整座设施比外界负压。

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 方框内依次出现气锁、安全柜、高压灭菌器、淋浴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an airlock, a biological safety cabinet, an autoclave and a shower appear inside the box. No people.
shots.narration: 气锁进，淋浴出，内有安全柜和灭菌器，

shots.section_title: 一座防护设施由什么组成
shots.scene: 方框下方出现一条蓝色污水处理带和循环图标
shots.prompt_en: A blue effluent treatment band with a recycle icon appears below the box. No people.
shots.narration: 楼下还有污水处理系统。

shots.scene: 一级实验室：开放台面，学生在做普通教学实验
shots.prompt_en: A basic teaching laboratory with open benches where the young male student does a simple class experiment.
shots.narration: 一级实验室用于基础教学科研，

shots.scene: 开放台面图标，病原体图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An open bench icon with a pathogen icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开放台面，不处理病原体。

shots.scene: 二级实验室门上贴生物危害标志，小研穿实验服戴手套
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a biohazard warning sign; the female graduate student wears a lab coat and gloves.
shots.narration: 二级用于诊断和研究，

shots.scene: 规范操作图标、防护用品图标、标志图标并列
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: good technique, protective equipment and a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 规范操作加防护，挂好标识，

shots.scene: 二级实验室一角新装了一台生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: A newly installed biological safety cabinet in the corner of a level two laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 加装安全柜，安全再上一层。

shots.scene: 三级实验室外观：厚重的门、门禁读卡器、生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A level three laboratory entrance with a heavy door, a card reader and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 三级叫防护实验室，

shots.scene: 图标：放大镜下的病原体和试管
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pathogen under a magnifying glass and a test tube. No people.
shots.narration: 用于特殊诊断和较高危害病原研究。

shots.scene: 防护服、向内箭头、门禁卡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: protective clothing, an inward arrow and an access card. No people.
shots.narration: 三级要防护、定向气流和门禁，

shots.scene: 开放台面被打叉，安全柜打勾
shots.prompt_en: An open bench icon crossed out with a red X next to a biological safety cabinet icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所有操作都在安全柜里做。

shots.scene: 四级实验室图标：气锁、正压防护服人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a level four facility: an airlock and a figure in an inflated positive pressure suit. No people.
shots.narration: 四级是最高防护：

shots.scene: 防护服图标上有小破口，空气向外吹出
shots.prompt_en: A pressure suit icon with a small puncture where air blows outward. No people.
shots.narration: 穿正压防护服，破了也是往外吹，

shots.scene: 三级生物安全柜图标、双扉灭菌器图标、出口淋浴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sealed glove-box cabinet, a double-door autoclave and an exit shower. No people.
shots.narration: 用三级柜、双扉灭菌器、出口淋浴。

shots.scene: 老鼠图标旁边的实验室房子图标
shots.prompt_en: A mouse icon next to a laboratory building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 动物实验室，前面加个字母A；

shots.scene: 植物盆栽图标旁边的温室图标
shots.prompt_en: A potted plant icon next to a greenhouse icon. No people.
shots.narration: 植物实验室，后面加个P，

shots.scene: 温室里一株植物，旁边一个双螺旋图标
shots.prompt_en: A plant inside a greenhouse next to a DNA double helix icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因植物也可能要用到。

shots.scene: 三级台阶上加了一个加号，向四级借来一块砖
shots.prompt_en: A plus sign added to the third step, borrowing one brick from the fourth step. No people.
shots.narration: 加号表示借用了更高一级的设计。

shots.scene: 老李在空白地图上画圈选址
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer circles a location on a blank map.
shots.narration: 高等级实验室选址有讲究：

shots.scene: 地震、洪水图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Earthquake and flood icons crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 避开自然灾害多发地，

shots.scene: 城市密集楼群图标被打叉，郊外空地打勾
shots.prompt_en: A crowded city icon crossed out and an open suburban site with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 避开人口稠密区，

shots.scene: 电力和水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric plug and a water drop. No people.
shots.narration: 水电要有保障，

shots.scene: 应急车辆沿道路驶向实验楼
shots.prompt_en: An emergency response vehicle drives along a road toward the laboratory building. No people.
shots.narration: 应急队伍能及时赶到，

shots.scene: 冲突区域图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A conflict zone icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能建在冲突地区。

shots.section_title: 气流：从清洁区流向污染区
shots.scene: 淡蓝色空气流线像水一样流动
shots.prompt_en: Light blue air streamlines flowing like water. No people.
shots.narration: 空气会流动，能加压也能减压，
overlay: 气流：从清洁区流向污染区

shots.section_title: 气流：从清洁区流向污染区
shots.scene: 平面图左绿右红，箭头从绿流向红
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan, green on the left and red on the right, with arrows flowing from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 设计让空气从清洁区流向污染区，

shots.section_title: 气流：从清洁区流向污染区
shots.scene: 红区尽头的滤网，干净空气出去
shots.prompt_en: A filter at the far end of the red area with clean air passing out. No people.
shots.narration: 再经高效过滤排出去。

shots.scene: 示意图：人形在左，病原体在右，箭头从病原体吹向人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a person icon on the left, a pathogen icon on the right, arrows blowing from the pathogen to the person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 风从病原体吹向人，不行。

shots.scene: 示意图：蓝色箭头从人身后吹过，橙色箭头从病原体另一侧排出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: blue arrows blow from behind the person, and orange arrows leave past the pathogen on the far side. No people.
shots.narration: 风从人身后来，经过病原体，

shots.scene: 橙色箭头穿过滤网离开
shots.prompt_en: Orange arrows pass through a filter and leave. No people.
shots.narration: 从另一头过滤排出。

shots.scene: 地上有一滩溢洒，小研站在送风一侧，用吸水纸从外向内覆盖
shots.prompt_en: A spill on the floor; the female graduate student stands on the upwind side and covers it with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 地上洒了，从清洁一侧处理，

shots.scene: 脚印踩进溢洒区被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Footprints stepping into the spill area, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要踩进去。

shots.section_title: 负压：把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 粉色房间里飘着小红点，四周箭头向内
shots.prompt_en: A pink room with floating small red dots and inward arrows all around. No people.
shots.narration: 防护设施比外界负压，
overlay: 负压：把气溶胶关在里面

shots.section_title: 负压：把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 红点碰到门缝，被向内的气流推回
shots.prompt_en: Red dots reach a door gap and are pushed back by the inward airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 含病原的气溶胶跑不出去。

shots.scene: 移液器和离心机图标周围冒出小雾点
shots.prompt_en: Tiny mist dots rising around a pipette icon and a centrifuge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 移液、离心都会产生气溶胶。

shots.scene: 小研戴着口罩防护，周围仍有些小雾点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a mask while a few mist dots float nearby.
shots.narration: 防护用品护住人，

shots.scene: 洗衣机漂洗衣服，泡沫一遍遍被冲走
shots.prompt_en: A washing machine rinsing clothes, foam washed away cycle after cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 可气溶胶多了，要靠持续换气，

shots.scene: 房间内气流一遍遍穿过，把雾点带走进入滤网
shots.prompt_en: Airflow sweeps through the room again and again, carrying mist dots into a filter. No people.
shots.narration: 像漂洗衣服一样把它带走。

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 高效过滤器剖面：一层层褶皱滤材
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a high efficiency filter showing pleated layers of filter media. No people.
shots.narration: 高效过滤器有严格的效率标准。
overlay: 高效过滤器：原理与更换

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 放大的纤维网，小颗粒撞上被粘住
shots.prompt_en: Magnified fiber mesh where small particles collide and stick. No people.
shots.narration: 纤维层层拦截，颗粒被截住，

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 更小的颗粒弯弯曲曲移动，最终也被纤维抓住
shots.prompt_en: Even smaller particles zigzag and are finally caught by fibers. No people.
shots.narration: 更小的颗粒乱飘，也会被抓住。

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 过滤器四周的密封条特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the sealing gasket around a filter housing. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤器靠密封条装好，不漏风。

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 老李穿全套防护，用大袋子罩住旧过滤器取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in full protective gear pulls an old filter out inside a large plastic bag.
shots.narration: 更换时袋进袋出，由专人做，

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 袋装旧过滤器贴生物危害标志，旁边回收图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bagged old filter with a biohazard warning sign, and a reuse icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 去污后废弃，不能再用。

shots.section_title: 高效过滤器：原理与更换
shots.scene: 日历图标和过滤器图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a filter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用久了滤材会老化，要按期换。

shots.scene: 三层楼剖面：顶层风机、中层实验室和办公室、底层水罐
shots.prompt_en: A three-story cutaway: fans on the top floor, laboratories and offices in the middle, tanks in the basement. No people.
shots.narration: 这类设施通常至少分三层：

shots.scene: 顶层风机和空调机组亮起
shots.prompt_en: The fans and air handling units on the top floor light up. No people.
shots.narration: 上层管空气，中层做实验办公，

shots.scene: 底层水罐亮起，管道从上层淋浴和水槽接下来
shots.prompt_en: The basement tanks light up with pipes running down from showers and sinks above. No people.
shots.narration: 底层收集处理全部废水。

shots.section_title: 进门路线：更衣、气锁、实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰在更衣区换上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student changes into a lab coat in a changing area.
shots.narration: 进实验室先在更衣区换装，
overlay: 进门路线：更衣、气锁、实验室

shots.section_title: 进门路线：更衣、气锁、实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰走进一个两头有门的小间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a small chamber with doors at both ends.
shots.narration: 经过负压的气锁，

shots.section_title: 进门路线：更衣、气锁、实验室
shots.scene: 平面图：更衣区、气锁、防护实验室三块依次排列，箭头贯穿
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with three blocks in a row and an arrow running through them. No people.
shots.narration: 才进入防护实验室。

shots.scene: 示意图：新风经过滤器送进房间
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: fresh air passes through a filter into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 送进来的风先过滤，保护人员；

shots.scene: 示意图：房间里的风经过滤器抽出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: room air is drawn out through a filter. No people.
shots.narration: 排出去的风也要过滤。

shots.scene: 屋顶排风机把气流竖直向高空喷出，逐渐散开
shots.prompt_en: A roof exhaust fan blows the air straight up high into the sky where it spreads out. No people.
shots.narration: 屋顶风机把风送到高空稀释。

shots.scene: 老李看着过滤箱上的压差表，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank pressure gauge on a filter housing.
shots.narration: 压差表是监测的关键。

shots.scene: 控制面板红灯亮，风机图标停转
shots.prompt_en: A control panel with a red light on and a fan icon stopped. No people.
shots.narration: 防护一旦失效，系统会停机。

shots.scene: 淋浴、洗手池、灭菌器的废水管汇向地下室
shots.prompt_en: Drain pipes from a shower, a hand sink and an autoclave converge toward the basement. No people.
shots.narration: 淋浴、洗手、灭菌器的废水，

shots.scene: 三个罐子依次排列：红、黄、绿
shots.prompt_en: Three tanks in a row colored red, yellow and green. No people.
shots.narration: 先进暂存罐，再进消毒罐，

shots.scene: 消毒罐旁一份空白规程和计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet and a timer icon beside the disinfection tank. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒剂和时间按规程定，

shots.scene: 绿色中和罐后箭头流向排放口
shots.prompt_en: An arrow flows from the green neutralization tank to the outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 中和后才排放。

shots.scene: 老李在空白记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes in a blank logbook beside the tanks.
shots.narration: 全程监测，留好记录。

shots.scene: 实验楼入口的门禁闸机和读卡器
shots.prompt_en: Access gates and a card reader at the laboratory building entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 安保要在设计时就考虑：

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在监控室看空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The security officer watches blank monitor screens in a control room.
shots.narration: 门禁监控管住人，

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上一把锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 数据和资料也要加密管好。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜前操作，柜内向下的气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a biological safety cabinet with downward airflow arrows inside.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜挡住气溶胶和飞溅，

shots.scene: 三个图标：人、房间、试管，都在盾牌下
shots.prompt_en: Three icons under one shield: a person, a room and a test tube. No people.
shots.narration: 保护人、环境，也保护样品。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作与离心机
shots.scene: 移液、涂片、离心三个图标，周围冒出小雾点
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pipetting, smearing a slide and a centrifuge, each with small mist dots. No people.
shots.narration: 移液、涂片、离心都会产生气溶胶。
overlay: 产生气溶胶的操作与离心机

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作与离心机
shots.scene: 离心机转头盖上密封盖
shots.prompt_en: A sealed lid is placed on a centrifuge rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 离心要用密封转头或安全杯，

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作与离心机
shots.scene: 小研把整个密封转头拿进安全柜，在柜内打开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the sealed rotor into the biological safety cabinet and opens it inside.
shots.narration: 拿进安全柜里再打开。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作与离心机
shots.scene: 离心机放在安全柜内运转，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge running inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机别放进柜里运行，会扰乱气流。

shots.scene: 安全柜剖面：室内空气进入，经风机和滤网排出
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a safety cabinet: room air enters, passes a fan and a filter, and exits. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的风过滤后排走，

shots.scene: 柜顶排风管直接接入大楼风管
shots.prompt_en: The cabinet exhaust pipe connects directly into the building duct. No people.
shots.narration: 一种是排风管直接接入大楼风管，

shots.scene: 柜顶上方留空隙，罩着一个集气罩
shots.prompt_en: A collection hood above the cabinet top with a small gap between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一种是上方罩个集气罩，便于平衡。

shots.scene: 风管里一片风阀随风速转动，旁边电脑图标
shots.prompt_en: A damper vane inside a duct turning with airspeed, next to a computer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风阀随风速自动调节，有备用接管。

shots.scene: 老李对着柜顶管道查看，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the duct above a cabinet holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 怎么连接，由工程人员按柜型定。

shots.section_title: 柜内布局：从洁到污，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 安全柜台面俯视：左侧干净物品，中间操作区，右侧废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a cabinet work surface: clean items on the left, work area in the middle, a waste bag on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内从洁到污摆放，
overlay: 柜内布局：从洁到污，不挡格栅

shots.section_title: 柜内布局：从洁到污，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 小研用左手习惯，把布局左右对调
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, being left-handed, mirrors the layout.
shots.narration: 左右按自己的习惯定。

shots.section_title: 柜内布局：从洁到污，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 前格栅上放着纸巾和试管，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Tissues and tubes lying on the front grille of the cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前后格栅上不放纸巾和管子。

shots.section_title: 柜内布局：从洁到污，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 气流向下，在台面前沿被吸走，远离操作者
shots.prompt_en: Airflow goes down and is drawn away at the front edge, away from the worker. No people.
shots.narration: 风向下走，从人身边吸走。

shots.scene: 七个空白卡片排成一列，配图标
shots.prompt_en: Seven blank cards in a column, each with an icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用好安全柜，记住七件事：

shots.scene: 证书图标、位置图标、摆放图标依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: A certificate icon, a location pin icon and a layout icon light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 认证、位置、物品摆放，

shots.scene: 文件、喷壶、扳手图标依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: A document icon, a spray bottle icon and a wrench icon light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程用，清洁消毒，定期维护。

shots.scene: 电话图标和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon and a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急维修也要有规程。

shots.scene: 平面图：门在一端，安全柜在另一端远处
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with the door at one end and the safety cabinet at the far end. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜放在远离门口的里端，

shots.scene: 门口来回走动的人形和空调出风口被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A busy doorway and an air conditioning vent next to the cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 避开门口、风口和走动气流，

shots.scene: 两台安全柜紧挨着，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two safety cabinets placed right next to each other, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也别和别的安全柜挤在一起。

shots.scene: 小研坐在可调座椅上，手臂放松，旁边计时器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits on an adjustable chair with relaxed arms, a timer icon beside her.
shots.narration: 座椅高度合适，避免久坐劳损。

shots.scene: 样本盒在实验台上，只把管子转进柜内打开
shots.prompt_en: A sample box on the bench; only the tubes are moved into the cabinet to be opened. No people.
shots.narration: 样本拿进柜里才开。

shots.scene: 废物袋从柜内进入双扉灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A waste bag goes from the cabinet into a double-door autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 废物封好，送去高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 安全柜侧面贴着空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A blank certification label on the side of a safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜要按国家标准定期检测。

shots.scene: 小研看了一眼标签上的日期，点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the blank label and nods.
shots.narration: 用前先确认检测在有效期。

shots.scene: 小研用喷壶和纸巾擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the work surface with a spray bottle and paper towels.
shots.narration: 使用前先消毒擦拭，

shots.scene: 规程卡片上依次亮起：摆放、溢洒、废物、用后去污图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card with icons lighting up: layout, spill, waste and cleaning. No people.
shots.narration: 摆放、溢洒、废物、用后去污，

shots.scene: 空白文件夹上一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank folder with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步都要写进规程。

shots.scene: 废物桶里套着两只生物安全袋
shots.prompt_en: A waste container lined with two biohazard bags, one inside the other. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内废物用两层袋装，

shots.scene: 吸头刺破一层袋，外层仍完好
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip pokes through the inner bag while the outer bag stays intact. No people.
shots.narration: 一层被戳破，还有一层兜着。

shots.scene: 小研在柜内扎紧袋口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties the bag closed inside the safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 装完在柜内封口，

shots.scene: 小研用喷壶喷袋子外表面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays the outer surface of the bag.
shots.narration: 外表面消毒后，送去灭菌。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三层楼模型旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the three-story building model.
shots.narration: 回顾一下：五招要一起用。

shots.scene: 三层楼模型：上层风机、中层实验室、下层水罐
shots.prompt_en: The building model: fans on top, laboratories in the middle, tanks below. No people.
shots.narration: 楼分三层，级别越高要求越多。

shots.scene: 从清洁区流向污染区的箭头和负压图标
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from the clean zone to the dirty zone and a minus pressure icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风从清洁流向污染，保持负压。

shots.scene: 安全柜、证书、双层袋三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety cabinet, a certificate and a double bag. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜要检测、放对、按规程用。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着安全柜认证标和摆放位置图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a cabinet certification mark and a placement icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜要检测、放对、按规程用。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李站在实验楼前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the facility engineer stand in front of the laboratory building and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 设施靠得住，操作守规矩，再见！
